basic_profile.bio: A 34-year-old from Wisconsin trying to navigate the challenging path of sobriety while balancing work as a mechanical engineer. In my free time, I delve into philosophical readings, particularly the works of Krishnamurti, which offer me solace and perspective. I live alone in a small apartment and am currently single, focusing on my personal growth and well-being. My typical online hours are evenings after work, where I engage with communities that support personal development and sobriety.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in engineering, having graduated with a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Wisconsin. My interest in philosophy and personal development stems from self-study and attending local discussion groups. Recently, I've been exploring topics related to sobriety, often diving into self-help books and online resources.
